responsibility: Defines the shared call-convention data model and ABI computation entry points for rustc_target, including pass modes, argument attributes and extensions, cast targets, calling-convention enums/parsing, and the target-dispatch logic that adjusts FnAbi values for each architecture and ABI family.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the `asm/mod.rs` register-framework module and the `spec` `mod.rs` files for target descriptions, this `mod.rs` owns the shared function-call ABI model—`PassMode`, argument attributes/extensions, calling-convention parsing, and dispatch into per-architecture FnAbi computation.
